Coram : HEMANT GUPTA*, VIKRAM NATH
Service Law – Promotion – Special drive for filling up backlog vacancies vis-à-vis regular promotion – Distinction between ad hoc promotions and regular promotions – Held: Distinction between a special drive for filling up backlog vacancies and regular promotion to and the unreserved categories, is too obvious – While filling up vacancies by way of promotion on regular basis, a Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) is constituted and the profile of the candidates coming within the zone of consideration is prepared – But in a special drive
Decision Date : 10-08-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3314/2010 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
